description: This file defines a set of unit tests for the AdoNetQueueAdapterFactory class and its related classes, testing its behavior across different relational database backends like SQL Server, MySQL, and PostgreSQL. It verifies adapter creation, failure handling, cache retrieval, stream queue mapping, and factory static methods.

classes.name: SqlServerAdoNetQueueAdapterFactoryTests
classes.description: Test class for AdoNetQueueAdapterFactory using SQL Server.

classes.name: MySqlAdoNetQueueAdapterFactoryTests
classes.description: Test class for AdoNetQueueAdapterFactory using MySQL.

classes.name: PostgreSqlAdoNetQueueAdapterFactoryTests
classes.description: Test class for AdoNetQueueAdapterFactory using PostgreSQL.

classes.name: AdoNetQueueAdapterFactoryTests
classes.description: Abstract base class containing shared setup and tests for AdoNetQueueAdapterFactory across multiple database providers.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Sets up the relational storage testing environment before each test.

methods.name: AdoNetQueueAdapterFactory_CreatesAdapter
methods.description: Test that the factory creates an adapter instance correctly.

methods.name: AdoNetQueueAdapterFactory_GetsDeliveryFailureHandler
methods.description: Test that the factory returns a failure handler appropriately.

methods.name: AdoNetQueueAdapterFactory_GetsQueueAdapterCache
methods.description: Test retrieval of the queue adapter cache.

methods.name: AdoNetQueueAdapterFactory_GetsStreamQueueMapper
methods.description: Test retrieval of the stream queue mapper.

methods.name: AdoNetQueueAdapterFactory_ConstructsViaStaticFactory
methods.description: Test constructing a factory instance via the static factory method.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Implements cleanup after tests; currently a no-op.
